facts.claim: Default exec security is `full` for gateway/node hosts and ask default `off`.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Session permission modes read-only/guarded/workspace/full; `full` requires operator.admin.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: GHSA-3hcm-ggvf-rch5 exec allowlist bypass via command substitution in double quotes; GHSA-gv46-4xfq-jv58 (critical) RCE via node invoke approval bypass.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D01.rationale: Capable model (deny/allowlist/full x ask off/on-miss/always, per-session modes, binding of executables, LLM reviewer) but the shipped default for host exec is security=full / ask=off.

facts.claim: 'Sandboxing is off by default'; Gateway process always stays on the host.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: GHSA-9p3r-hh9g-5cmg (critical): sandbox escape via TOCTOU in remote FS bridge readFile (<=2026.3.28).
facts.label: from-official-docs

D02.rationale: Sandbox backends exist (Docker/Podman/SSH/OpenShell) but are off by default; Gateway always on host; several sandbox-escape advisories.

facts.claim: Secret egress proxy and traffic allowlist documented as default-off.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: GHSA-56f2-hvwg-5743 SSRF in image tool remote fetch; GHSA-wfp2-v9c7-fh79 SSRF via media URL hydration (2026-02).
facts.label: from-official-docs

D03.rationale: Optional secret egress proxy with traffic allowlist (default-off); SSRF fixes (several advisories); no default egress restriction.

facts.claim: Gateway bind default loopback; auth required by default; non-loopback binds require auth; onboarding generates token.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: GHSA-8rh7-6779-cjqq (critical): CWD .env injection bypasses host-env policy and allows config takeover (<=2026.3.24).
facts.label: from-official-docs

D04.rationale: No repo-trust concept; trust is gateway auth + pairing + scopes. Advisories show cwd .env and config-takeover paths. Gateway auth required by default and loopback bind, which is a sound default.

facts.claim: `openclaw mcp configure <server> --approval approve|prompt|auto`; Allow Always grants per exact server+tool.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D05.rationale: MCP defined in gateway config with per-server approval modes and durable per-tool grants; probe/doctor tooling; tool-change detection not documented.

facts.claim: ClawHub is the public skills registry; `openclaw skills verify @owner/<slug>` prints trust envelope / Skill Card.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Koi Security reported 341 malicious skills among 2,857 audited on ClawHub (campaign 'ClawHavoc', AMOS stealer); later counts higher; secondary reporting only.
facts.label: third-party-report

facts.claim: GHSA-qrq5-wjgg-rvqw (critical): path traversal in plugin installation, fixed 2026.2.1.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D06.rationale: ClawHub public registry with `skills verify` trust envelope and Skill Cards, yet a large-scale malicious-skill campaign was found; plugin-install path traversal (critical) fixed.

facts.claim: Recommended permissions 700 on ~/.openclaw and 600 on openclaw.json; plaintext credentials remain agent-readable.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Jan 2026: researcher Jamieson O'Reilly reported hundreds of publicly exposed Clawdbot control servers leaking API keys, bot tokens, OAuth secrets and chat histories (secondary report).
facts.label: third-party-report

facts.claim: GHSA-g8p2-7wf7-98mq: Control UI trusted gatewayUrl query param and sent the stored gateway token to it (1-click RCE), clawdbot <= 2026.1.28, fixed 2026.1.29.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D07.rationale: Good guidance (700/600, SecretRefs, audit command) and honest warnings, but plaintext tokens in config/.env are common and the Jan 2026 exposures leaked keys at scale.

facts.claim: `openclaw agent exec` is the recommended headless entry for CI; temporary state dir removed after run; --config pins config; --auth-env-only restricts credentials.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D08.rationale: `agent exec` is a purpose-built CI entry point with ephemeral state, pinned config and --auth-env-only; but inherits ordinary config (host exec default full) and has no official CI action.

facts.claim: MEMORY.md long-term memory and memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md daily notes in the workspace; memory-flush runs expose only read and append-only write.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: SECURITY.md: anyone who can operate an agent can make it do anything that agent can do; session ownership is not a boundary.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D09.rationale: Persistent, cross-session, agent-writable memory files fed back into prompts; provenance records and flush restrictions mitigate; multi-user channels widen the poisoning surface.

facts.claim: GHSA-g5cg-8x5w-7jpm (critical): heartbeat context inheritance bypasses sandbox via senderIsOwner escalation (<=2026.3.28).
facts.label: from-official-docs

D10.rationale: Per-agent sandbox/tool policies and multi-agent isolation docs, but advisories show sub-run/heartbeat inheritance bypassing sandbox; shared-gateway users are not isolated.

facts.claim: Gateway keeps bounded metadata-only audit ledger; never stores prompts, bodies, tool args/results.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: OpenTelemetry and Prometheus docs exist.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D11.rationale: Metadata-only durable audit ledger in the state DB, decision receipts, OTel and Prometheus exporters, log masking; content is deliberately not stored in the ledger.

facts.claim: Automatic update checks send a daily request by default (version, OS, Node, arch); anonymous feature stats are opt-in/off by default.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D12.rationale: Daily update-check request by default with documented fields and a way to disable; feature statistics opt-in; `openclaw telemetry show` shows the payload.

facts.claim: npm dist-tags: latest 2026.10.3, extended-stable 2026.8.35, beta 2026.10.5-beta.3.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: README: `npm install -g openclaw@latest --allow-scripts=openclaw`.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D13.rationale: Installer scripts plus npm with explicit lifecycle-script contract, Docker/Nix, appcast updates, stable/beta/extended-stable dist-tags; no signature/checksum statement for install.sh found.

facts.claim: gateway.roles / operator scopes (operator.read/write/admin/pairing) and trusted-proxy identityScopes.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Repeated critical scope-escalation advisories (operator.pairing -> operator.admin) in March 2026.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D14.rationale: Operator scopes/roles, trusted-proxy auth, required creator-role sandbox policy and team-server docs give central control; no OS-level managed-settings file found.

facts.claim: 722 published repo security advisories (14 critical, 249 high, 390 medium, 69 low) at access time.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: SECURITY.md: private GHSA or security@openclaw.ai; no paid bug bounty.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D15.rationale: Detailed SECURITY.md and trust page, private GHSA flow, and very high advisory volume with fixes (722 published, 39 with CVE ids); no paid bounty.
